recipe.title: Recipe Editor
recipe.prepared_weight_auto: Automatic suggestion. Edit to enter a measured weight.
recipe.prepared_weight_manual: Entered weight. Ingredient, quantity or preparation changes recalculate it.
recipe.prepared_weight_failed: Estimate unavailable. Uses the entered quantity.
recipe.prepared_weight_unsupported: No documented cooking yield. Uses the entered quantity.
recipe.prepared_weight_estimated: Estimated with a documented yield (×{factor}). Source: Bognár 2002, {table}. Edit to enter a measured weight.
recipe.final_prepared_weight_help: Total prepared weight of all ingredients.
recipe.review_description: Review your ingredients and quantities before calculating each recipe’s score.
recipe.name: Recipe name
recipe.compute_error: Could not compute the score. Please try again.
recipe.no_score: No score available. Add ingredients with weights to compute the score.

column_help.prepared_weight_grams: Weight of this ingredient as served. Uses documented cooking yields where available, otherwise the entered quantity.
column_help.ciqual_food: Generic food from the French Ciqual database, providing nutrition values for this ingredient.
column_help.agribalyse_food: Food from the Agribalyse environmental database, used to calculate the Green Score.
column_help.off_product: Packaged product used as the nutrition reference. When empty, the generic Ciqual food is used.
column_help.labels: Certifications carried by this ingredient, such as organic or fair trade. These can affect the Green Score.
column_help.origin: Country where this ingredient was produced. When World is selected, conservative penalties for origin and transport are used.
column_help.fresh_plant: Fresh fruit or vegetables whose environmental impact can depend on seasonality.
column_help.in_season: Whether this fresh fruit or vegetable is in season at the place and time the recipe is prepared.

recipe.incomplete_nutrition_reference: This reference is missing data required for Nutri-Score.
recipe.incomplete_environmental_reference: This reference has no usable environmental data for Green Score.
recipe.prepared_reference_required: Choose a nutrition reference for the ingredient in its weighed state.
recipe.unsupported_nutrition_preparation: Nutrition data for this preparation is unavailable.
recipe.off_ciqual_fallback: Open Food Facts nutrition data is incomplete. Ciqual values are used instead.
recipe.zero_quantity: Excluded from the calculation because the quantity is 0 grams.
recipe.invalid_prepared_weight: Enter a prepared weight greater than 0.
recipe.required_nutrition_reference: Choose a Ciqual food or an Open Food Facts product for nutrition calculations.
recipe.export_failed: Could not export recipes. Check quantities and portions, then try again.

homepage.title: Score My Recipe - Open Food Facts
homepage.badge: The open-source tool for environmental assessment of recipes
homepage.hero_title: Calculate the environmental impact of your recipes
homepage.hero_description: Come with your existing recipes. Our tool adapts to what you have, instantly calculates the Green-Score and helps you move towards more sustainable menus.
homepage.section2_title: Works for home and professional kitchens
homepage.section2_description: Beyond single recipes, easily score many recipes with reliable data.
homepage.feature1_description: Easily adjust a recipe's impact by "jamming" on quantities or testing ingredient substitutions on the fly.
homepage.feature2_title: A transparent methodology grounded in PEF/Agribalyse
homepage.feature2_description: A transparent calculation methodology, based on the rigour of the public PEF/Agribalyse database carried by ADEME.
homepage.feature3_description: Rely on a validated indicator already identified by millions of consumers on Open Food Facts and Yuka.
homepage.footer_text: An open-source project led by Open Food Facts, designed to help us reduce the impact of at-home cooking, out-of-home dining and catering.
homepage.footer_badge: Project carried out collaboratively thanks to the support of ADEME's Call for Commons

onboarding.title: How to score your recipe
onboarding.subtitle: Calculate the environmental impact of your culinary creations in seconds.
onboarding.step1_desc: Paste or type your ingredients with their quantities (e.g. 200g flour, 3 eggs).
onboarding.step2_desc: We recognise your ingredients and match them to the official Agribalyse/PEF database.
onboarding.step3_desc: Get your score from A to F, see missing matches, and optimise your recipe's impact.

helpers.recipe_text: Enter each ingredient on a new line with its quantity (e.g. 200g flour, 3 eggs, 100g sugar).
helpers.country: Country where the recipe is prepared or consumed, used to calculate transport distances.
